message: The non-streaming request of POST /chat (named by the x-fern-type-name of its request body schema) is named "ChatInput", which is already declared by the schema components.schemas.Foo (named by its x-fern-type-name) at #/components/schemas/Foo/x-fern-type-name. fern check fails with "ChatInput is already declared". Fern splits an operation with an x-fern-streaming stream-condition into a streaming and a non-streaming endpoint, each with its own request. Name the two requests with x-fern-request-name on the operation and stream-request-name in x-fern-streaming.
